name: The heat out
prompt: The radiators are cold. The furnace in the basement has stopped, and the landlord isn't picking up.

outcome.line: {you} waited out a night without heat.

failure.told: Nobody comes until the next afternoon. The cold gets into everything.
failure.line: {you} spent a night and a day without heat.

outcome.told: The heater clicks and hums, and one room is warm.
outcome.line: {you} bought a space heater when the furnace stopped.
